CHAP USTUN:
7) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous.' SURAT: jilmayib turgan ayol (Joanne) gazeta bilan. Matn: That morning Joanne 1) ...... (wake up) very early. She 2) ...... (dress) and 3) ...... (leave) for work at 8:30 am. As she 4) ...... (drive) down Main Street, she 5) ...... (notice) something strange. No one 6) ...... (stand) at the bus stop and there 7) ...... (be) very few cars in the streets. A few minutes later she 8) ...... (stop) at the local newsagent's to buy a newspaper. "Mrs Turner, what are you doing here so early on a Sunday morning?" 9) ...... (ask) Mr Dilon. "Sunday?" 10) ...... (repeat) Joanne. She 11) ...... (stare) at Mr Dilon and 12) ...... (start) laughing.
8) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous.' 1 It ...... (rain) heavily all day yesterday. 2 What ...... (you/do) at six o'clock yesterday morning? 3 Ruby ...... (slip) and ...... (fall) as she ...... (cross) the street. 4 My brother ...... (fix) the washing machine while I ...... (water) the plants. 5 The children ...... (try) to make a sandcastle when it ...... (start) to rain. 6 Fred ...... (feed) the dog when suddenly he ...... (hear) somebody calling his name. 7 He ...... (lose) his balance and ...... (fall) to the ground while he ...... (ride) his bicycle. 8 ...... (I/tell) you what ...... (happen) to me last Sunday? 9 When James ...... (open) his eyes he ...... (see) his mother. 10 When Tom ...... (come) home from work I ...... (talk) on the phone.

O'NG USTUN:
9) 'Underline the correct form of the verb.' A: What were you doing/did you do at the weekend? B: Well, we painted/were painting the sitting-room when the lights were going/went off! A: What was happening/happened? B: Jenny was slipping/slipped off the ladder and was breaking/broke her leg! A: What did the children do/were the children doing at the time? B: Jules was playing/played with the dog and Claire was talking/talked on the phone. Then everything was going/went black!
'Revision: Units 1 - 4':
10) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Please don't talk so ...... . I'm trying to study. A louder B loudest C loudly. 2 This book ...... be hers. She doesn't like Shakespeare. A can't B must C can. 3 Janet ...... her hair at the moment. A washes B is washing C washed. 4 Brad ...... a motorcycle last year. A bought B buy C buys. 5 "I love going on picnics." "So ...... I." A am B does C do. 6 This is the ...... attractive house in our neighbourhood. A more B much C most. 7 James ...... put the broken glass into the rubbish bin. A more carefully B carefully C careful. 8 My father doesn't ...... in a travel agency. A works B work C working. 9 "Is he a sailor?" "Yes, he ...... ." A be B is C isn't. 10 Kathy's mother ...... got long, black hair. A has B have C haven't. 11 She ...... to be a nurse but now she's a doctor. A uses B used C use. 12 Linda won first prize. She ...... be thrilled. A can B must C can't.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '23'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
JOANNE'NING YAKShANBASI - HIKOYA.

  Ketma-ket qisqa harakatlar →
  Past Simple; 'As she ...' va fon
  (hech kim turmagan edi) →
  Continuous.

  1 woke up  2 dressed  3 left
  4 was driving (As she ... - uzun)
  5 noticed  6 was standing (fon)
  7 were (fon - holat)
  8 stopped  9 asked  10 repeated
  11 stared  12 started

  HAZIL: Joanne yakshanba ekanini
  unutib ishga ketgan!


⚠ 'THE NEWSAGENT'S':

  = gazeta do'koni.


⚠ 'TO STARE AT':

  = tikilib qaramoq.

items.textEn: That morning Joanne ___ (wake up) very early.
She ___ (dress)
and ___ (leave) for work at 8:30 am.
As she ___ (drive) down Main Street,
she ___ (notice) something strange.
No one ___ (stand) at the bus stop
and there ___ (be) very few cars in the streets.
A few minutes later she ___ (stop) at the local newsagent's to buy a newspaper.
"Mrs Turner, what are you doing here so early on a Sunday morning?" ___ (ask) Mr Dilon.
"Sunday?" ___ (repeat) Joanne.
She ___ (stare) at Mr Dilon
and ___ (start) laughing.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or past continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIMPLE YOKI CONTINUOUS?

  1 was raining (all day - davom)
  2 were you doing (at six
    o'clock - ma'lum payt)
  3 slipped, fell (qisqa) / was
    crossing (as - uzun)
  4 was fixing / was watering
    (while - ikki uzun)
  5 were trying (uzun) / started
    (when - qisqa)
  6 was feeding (uzun) / heard
    (suddenly - qisqa)
  7 lost, fell (qisqa) / was riding
    (while - uzun)
  8 Did I tell / happened (ikkala
    qisqa)
  9 opened / saw (ikkala qisqa)
  10 came (qisqa) / was talking
     (uzun)


⚠ 'TO LOSE YOUR BALANCE':

  = muvozanatni yo'qotmoq.


⚠ 'A SANDCASTLE':

  = qum qal'a.

items.textEn: It ___ (rain) heavily all day yesterday.
What ___ (you/do) at six o'clock yesterday morning?
Ruby ___ (slip) and ___ (fall) as she ___ (cross) the street.
My brother ___ (fix) the washing machine while I ___ (water) the plants.
The children ___ (try) to make a sandcastle when it ___ (start) to rain.
Fred ___ (feed) the dog when suddenly he ___ (hear) somebody calling his name.
He ___ (lose) his balance and ___ (fall) to the ground while he ___ (ride) his bicycle.
___ (I/tell) you what ___ (happen) to me last Sunday?
When James ___ (open) his eyes he ___ (see) his mother.
When Tom ___ (come) home from work I ___ (talk) on the phone.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct form of the verb.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIALOG - ChIROQ O'ChGAN KEChA.

  What WERE YOU DOING at the
    weekend? (nima qilayotgan
    edingiz)
  we WERE PAINTING when the lights
    WENT OFF (uzun + qisqa)
  What HAPPENED? (qisqa)
  Jenny SLIPPED and BROKE her leg
    (qisqa)
  What WERE THE CHILDREN DOING at
    the time? (o'sha payt - uzun)
  Jules WAS PLAYING and Claire WAS
    TALKING (uzun)
  Then everything WENT black
    (qisqa)


⚠ 'THE LIGHTS WENT OFF':

  = chiroqlar o'chdi.


⚠ 'EVERYTHING WENT BLACK':

  = hamma yoq qorong'i bo'ldi.

This is the ___ attractive house in our neighbourhood.

items.uz: Jeyms singan shishani ehtiyotkorlik bilan axlat qutisiga soldi.

patterns.formula: What were you doing + VAQT? — I was + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: What were you doing at six o'clock yesterday morning? — I was sleeping.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha ertalab soat oltida nima qilayotgan edingiz? — Uxlayotgan edim.

patterns.formula: KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON + and + O'TGAN ZAMON + as/while + KIM + was + V-ing
patterns.exampleEn: Ruby slipped and fell as she was crossing the street.
patterns.exampleUz: Rubi ko'chani kesib o'tayotganda sirpanib yiqildi.

patterns.formula: As + KIM + was + V-ing, KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON + something strange
patterns.exampleEn: As she was driving down Main Street, she noticed something strange.
patterns.exampleUz: U Meyn ko'chasi bo'ylab haydab ketayotganda g'alati narsani payqadi.
